THE STUDENTS' POCKET PRESCRIBES.- ?t?y 
CHIDr. D. M. Macdonald, M.D., F.R.C.P.E. 9th Edition. Edinburgh; E. & D. Livingstone, 1925. 
Pp. 226. Price, 3s. net. 
In a miniature volume which will readily go into 
the vest pocket, the author has condensed no less than 
551 prescriptions with directions for use. They are 
arranged according to the diseases for which they 
are intended. 
There is a great deal of information on prescribing, 
a table of doses, a vocabulary, diet tables, etc. This 
handy and cheap volume will be found very useful 
by students and doctors. It has reached the 9th edition and is becoming increasingly popular.
